text: Handling deadlines well starts with good time management. When you have a lot of work, make a plan and break big tasks into smaller steps. Prioritization is also important, so focus on the most urgent jobs first. If you realize you cannot finish everything, use scope management: agree with others on what is essential and what can wait. Finally, communication is key. Tell your team or manager early if you have a problem, instead of waiting until the last minute. With these simple habits, you can stay calm, reduce stress, and meet your deadlines more successfully.
